The test image shows a corn leaf with numerous small, circular to oval spots scattered across the surface. Spots have tan/light brown centers with possible darker borders. No elongated lesions, no pustules. Affects the leaf.

Top candidates: Eyespot, Tar Spot, Holcus_Spot, Common_Rust (though rust typically has raised pustules).

Let me check reference images one at a time.
Eyespot reference shows small circular spots with bright yellow halos - somewhat similar distribution but the test image spots look more tan/brown, less yellow. Let me check Tar Spot.
Tar Spot shows small black/dark glossy dots - too dark compared to the test image's tan/brown spots. Let me check Holcus Spot.
Holcus Spot shows large isolated pale spots - doesn't match the many small spots in the test image. Let me check Common Rust.
Common Rust shows dark reddish-brown raised pustules - somewhat similar distribution but test image spots appear lighter/more tan. Let me check Southern Rust.
Southern Rust shows small orange/yellow-orange pustules - slightly different color from the test image. Let me check another Eyespot reference for better comparison.
This Eyespot reference shows small circular lesions with tan centers, darker rings, and yellow halos - very similar to the test image pattern. Let me check Physoderma Brown Spot as another candidate.

Physoderma shows tiny spots in distinct banded patterns with dark midrib spots - doesn't match the test image's random scatter. I need one more reference. Let me check another Eyespot for confirmation.

This third Eyespot reference confirms the pattern of many small scattered spots on green leaves.

**Summary of visual comparison:**
- **Eyespot** (best match): Small circular spots with tan centers, darker rings, and yellow halos scattered randomly across the leaf - closely matches the test image
- **Common Rust**: Darker reddish-brown raised pustules, different texture and color
- **Southern Rust**: Orange/cinnamon pustules predominantly on upper surface
- **Tar Spot**: Black glossy raised stromata - too dark
- **Holcus Spot**: Large isolated pale spots - doesn't match
- **Physoderma Brown Spot**: Tiny spots in distinct banded patterns with dark midrib lesions - doesn't match

The test image shows numerous small circular spots with tan/brown centers and darker borders, randomly distributed on a green corn leaf. This matches Eyespot most closely - especially the reference image Corn_Disease_25.jpg which shows the same tan-centered spots with darker rings scattered across the leaf.
